waybackify cache add [flags] <wayback-url>

Fetch one capture into a local bucket image

Fetch one capture into a local bucket image at <root> — the
wayback mirror's population path. Syncing that dir to
R2 / Fastly KV (rclone/wrangler/fastly tooling) IS deployment.

Output: files written under the shared key scheme; summary line on
stdout.

Arguments:
  <wayback-url>        full web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>/<original> replay URL

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>     cache root directory (the local bucket image) — required
  --output|-o <root>   deprecated alias of --root|-r
  --no-requisites      store only the named capture; skip its im_/cs_/js_/oe_ page requisites
  --help|-h            Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
